method: static FK grid; non-controlled qpos held at reset values; no mj_step
model_changes: temporary XML only: same five internal body exclusions and candidate equalities
candidate_definition: matching finger-button contact exists; contact.dist >= 0; contact.dist <= combined geom margins
interpretation: Closest-surface ranking uses contact-pair distance. The selected candidate minimizes tangential error within a diagnostic 0.2 to 0.4 mm clearance band. Site front offset is positive outside. Grid samples near the old target are rounded poses, not the exact target. These are static pairwise candidates, not full-body collision-free or dynamically validated targets.
